g.text: ASK DIRECT
"harming yourself?"
— opens rescue!
SAFETY PLAN
means + watcher +
numbers + return!
REFER TODAY
psychiatry + CPN +
follow-up YOU!
STIGMA: FIGHT IT
normalise + kind words
+ privacy fierce!
RELATIONSHIP
consistent + hopeful
+ human, always!
SUICIDE STEPS: ASK ("harming yourself…? plan…? means…? when…?") → SAFETY (means
restricted? watcher named? 24h cover?) → PLAN (written: warning signs + coping + numbers +
clinic!) → REFER (psychiatry/CPN TODAY!) → FOLLOW-UP (YOU call — "Thursday, I promised").
Document ALL (INF!). High risk? NEVER leave alone + escort referral.
WARNING SIGNS: giving away + goodbyes + "better off dead" + sudden calm after despair +
withdrawal + risk-taking + means-buying. Post-discharge + post-crisis WEEKS = peak danger
— follow-up is prevention.
GHANA PATHWAYS: ward → district doctor → CPN (community psych nurse!) → psychiatrist
(regional/teaching!) → Pantang/Ankaful Accra as needed. CHPS + pastors + family = support
ring. Know YOUR district's CPN NAME + NUMBER — referral is a person, not a form.
STIGMA FIGHT (Goffman!): normalise ("many mothers feel this…") + kind language (person-
first, always!) + privacy FIERCE (gossip kills help-seeking!) + chaining/beating REFUSED +
reported (prayer camps + homes — Mental Health Act protects!) + recovery STORIES shared.
THERAPEUTIC RELATIONSHIP: same nurse + predictable + hopeful ("treatment WORKS — I've
seen recovery!") + human (tea + time + humour kindly!) + boundaries (PRO-I!). Trust =
treatment adherence = recovery. Be the nurse they return to.
DEBRIEF YOU: suicides + attempts wound nurses — share + reflect + support (COM M02!).
Guilt reviewed honestly, never carried silently.
MANTRA: "ask, safe, plan, refer, follow — stigma fought, hope held."
